# Recipe Performance — points rollup (GENERATED by backtest.recipes)

Engine `5c793cbb4` · recipe set **recipe_set_v0** (values ILLUSTRATIVE — awaiting operator ratification; changes only by re-registration, counted in the trial log).

**OBSERVATIONAL ONLY** — touches nothing: not paper, not the ledger, not frozen_v1, not labels, not criteria. Directional fires only; same fires as the signal scoreboard, four harvests. Sealed windows and the lockbox span excluded. Points are mid-price MINUS each instrument's measured median cash spread per trade — idealized, not tradeable.

**Honest-fill rules (operator-ruled 2026-08-19, part of every recipe's definition):** (1) intrabar stop+target both reachable -> stop fills, always; (2) gap through a level -> filled at the gapped (worse) price; (3) trailing stops ratchet only, evaluated on settled bars; (4) EOD flat at each instrument's native session close.
